title: Vegan Moroccan Couscous Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious bowl filled with the traditional North African ingredients. This vegan couscous bowl is perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of Morrozan in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, bell pepper, and carrot. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the canned chickpeas and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add 1 cup of couscous to the pot and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and reduce the heat to low. Simmer for 5-7 minutes or until the couscous is tender and fluffy.
Fluff the couscous with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
